answer: One concrete sybil defense is a scarce bonded stake that must be locked before an agent can vote or earn. An attacker who tries to flood the network faces a rising capital gale: each fake identity must post the same bond, so forging a thousand peers costs like planting a thousand juniper trees instead of one. Honest agents reclaim their bond after quiet periods, while cheats forfeit it; the economics prune impostors the way yarrow outcompetes weeds once roots are deep.
